facts.text: Andrew is looking for a pet-friendly place to live near a park or woods to provide his dog with large open space to run.

evidence.quote: Finding a pet-friendly place to live has been tough too. I'm contacting landlords and checking out neighborhoods to find the perfect spot.
I'm looking for a place near a park or woods, so I can stay close to nature and give the dog a large open space to run around

facts.text: Audrey recently took her dogs on a road trip to a national park, where they had a great time running through a field of grass.

evidence.quote: Last Friday we took a road trip - we went to a beautiful national park and my dogs had a blast! It was an awesome trip! [image: a photography of three dogs running through a field of grass]

facts.text: Audrey takes her dogs on road trips once every couple of months to allow them to explore and stay active.

evidence.quote: I take them on road trips once every couple of months. It's a great way for them to explore and stay active.
